# 501 — Configuration_LoadFailed

Reports that an attempt to load configuration failed before a candidate could be obtained for validation\.

[All events](index.md) · [Configuration category](Category_Configuration.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ConfigurationEvents.LoadFailed%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.Exception%29)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 501 |
| Name | Configuration_LoadFailed |
| Category | [Configuration](Category_Configuration.md) |
| Event class | UnrecoverableWarning |
| Log level | Warning |

| Introduced | 0.0.8 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.Configuration.LoadFailed(@configurationName, @sourceName, @loadId, @reasonCode, @exception);
```

**Trigger:** Emit when a required configuration\-loading attempt fails during source access, reading, parsing, or deserialization\.

**Message template:** Configuration load failed\. Configuration: \{ConfigurationName\}\. Source: \{SourceName\}\. Load: \{LoadId\}\. Reason: \{ReasonCode\}\.

## Arguments

- `configurationName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical name of the configuration being loaded\.
- `sourceName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical source name\. Do not include credentials, connection strings, or sensitive paths or addresses\.
- `loadId` (`string`): The unique identifier of this loading attempt\. Use a new identifier for each retry or reload\.
- `reasonCode` (`string`): A stable application\-defined failure classification, such as SourceNotFound, SourceAccessDenied, SourceReadFailed, or SourceParseFailed\.
- `exception` (`Exception?`): The original exception when appropriate for the logging destination, or null when no exception occurred or its details must not be logged\.

## Remarks

- This event describes one failed loading attempt\. It does not establish that the application has no working configuration\.
- A failed reload may leave a previously accepted configuration active\. A failed initial load may instead require fallback or shutdown, according to application policy\.
- A missing optional source is not automatically a loading failure\. Emit only when the absence prevents the requested loading attempt from succeeding\.
- Parsing or deserialization failure prevents obtaining a candidate\. A successfully loaded candidate that violates application validation rules belongs to Configuration\_ValueIsInvalid and Configuration\_ValidationFailed\.
- Do not emit validation failure solely because loading failed\. If no candidate was obtained, validation need not begin\.
- LoadId identifies a loading attempt\. ValidationId identifies a validation attempt\. Use a logging scope or trace when correlation across these phases is required\.
- Use a small documented set of ReasonCode values\. Do not include configuration contents, credentials, connection strings, or raw source responses\.
- Exceptions can reveal source paths, configuration keys, or other sensitive details\. Pass the original exception only when appropriate for the logging destination; otherwise pass null\. Do not manufacture an exception solely for logging\.
- The exception travels through the logging exception channel and is not a message\-template property\.
- Cancellation and application shutdown are not configuration\-loading failures\.
- Report once at the boundary responsible for the loading attempt\. Avoid reporting the same failure again at each calling layer\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not load configuration, retry, reject a candidate, replace active settings, change application mode, or initiate shutdown\.
